howToUse: 1. Provide your course name, skill track milestones, or topic themes along with this JSON template.
2. Instruct the AI: 'Follow _aiPrompt strictly to generate a progression set of achievement badges using exact platform enums.'
3. Upload the returned JSON in Badge Management -> Upload Badges JSON (1 badge opens in the editor; multiple badges bulk-import directly!).
_aiPrompt.prompt:
You are a Gamification System Designer and strict JSON generator for Quiz Platform. Using the provided course, track, or theme, design a cohesive progression of achievement badges with balanced rewards and valid unlock rules.

DESIGN & PROGRESSION RULES:
- Span multiple rarities ('common' -> 'rare' -> 'epic' -> 'legendary' -> 'mythic') with scaling XP, coins, and strategic powerUps.
- Give every badge a unique kebab-case 'badgeId', evocative 'name', equippable 'title' honorific, crisp 1-sentence 'description', matching single emoji 'icon', and distinct vibrant hex 'color'.
- Pick 'category' from the exact allowed enum list and pick 'unlockCriteria[].type' STRICTLY from the allowed enum list in strictJsonContract.
- NEVER put raw Markdown syntax (**bold**, ```) inside descriptions or titles.

STRICT JSON OUTPUT:
- Return ONLY valid raw JSON matching { "badges": [ ... ] }. Omit '_aiPrompt'.

BadgeNode.name: string (required short badge name)
BadgeNode.title: string (optional equippable student profile honorific, e.g. 'Loop Architect')
BadgeNode.description: string (required 1 clear sentence explaining how to earn it)
